name: Forward premium
title: Forward Premium Calculator
desc: Our forward premium calculator can help you compare the forward rate and spot rate of a currency exchange rate.

c: forward_premium > 0
The forward rate is higher than the spot rate, so there is a forward premium.
forward_premium == 0
The forward rate and spot rate are the same, so there is no forward premium or forward discount.
forward_premium < 0
The forward rate is lower than the spot rate, so there is a forward discount.

name: Forward rate
